objective: Sustain and control the second phase of the operation already underway.
intendedChange: The group establishes whether increased flow is viable and makes a consequential adjustment to manage its cost or danger.
prohibitedPatterns: Do not resolve the local Blight source or conclude the prelude arc.
Do not relocate the party from the Gate of Silence shrine.
Do not invent the death of any Keeper or party member.
Do not introduce a new external threat or cliffhanger interruption.
Do not treat Kaelen as a passive tool; he must actively choose his level of engagement.

scenes.purpose: Elias observes the barrier's reaction to the initial pull and identifies the physical cost to Kaelen, establishing the immediate danger of the second phase.
scenes.intendedChange: The barrier begins to flicker under the increased load, and Kaelen shows visible signs of strain, prompting Elias to intervene.

scenes.purpose: Elias coordinates a tactical adjustment to the resonance frequency to stabilize the flow, testing the group's ability to work together under pressure.
scenes.intendedChange: The group successfully lowers the resonance to a sustainable level, preventing the barrier from shattering and allowing Kaelen to regain control.

scenes.purpose: Kaelen makes a conscious decision to sustain the adjusted flow, demonstrating his agency and the group's trust in his judgment.
scenes.intendedChange: The flow stabilizes at a viable level, and the group confirms that the second phase is sustainable without sacrificing Kaelen or the barrier.
